d:
Ghar par dadi-nani ke hath jaisa svad pane aur kathal ki kari ko speshal banane ka asli raz tin baton men chhipa hai;
Kathal ko sahi tarike se katna aur saph karna.
Khas deshi masalon ko sahi tarike se bhunna.
Ise sahi samay aur sahi tarike se pakana.
Agar ye tinon steps sahi hon, to kathal ki sabji ekdam lajvab banti hai aur khane vale ke munh se kathal ke chhilke nahin sirph 'vah-vah' nikalti hai is vidiyo men ye tinon steps bahut hi aasan aur sahi tarike se dikhae gae hain.
Ingredients for Spicy Kathal Curry
Kathal - Jackfruit - 300g
Haldi paudar - Turmeric Powder - ¾ tsp
